name: image-guided-assets
description: Create SVG and 3D assets from visual references, then render, compare, and refine them.

interface.shortDescription: Create SVG and 3D assets from visual references
interface.longDescription: Generate or reuse a visual reference, build an SVG or 3D asset, and refine the result through rendered comparisons. Includes checks for SVG contours and transparency and Blender geometry and materials.
defaultPrompt: Create an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle, using a visual reference to guide the design.
Create a 3D folding field camera in Blender, using a reference to guide its proportions and materials.
